name: Kurokawa Tadayoshi
source: A rich son, the likely successor to his family's fortune, the Kurokawa Zaibatsu. He is unaccostumed to the ways in the slums, but after waking up in a church in said slums, he starts to grow out of his former stuck-up ways. Likes to read, and is very smart.
